title: Vegas Visitor Numbers Fall While Hotel Rates Ease
description:
Vegas welcomed 3,034,900 visitors in August 2026, down 4.3% from a year earlier—but the slowdown was not uniform. This five-part countdown explains Las Vegas Strip gaming revenue, convention attendance, hotel occupancy, airport passenger traffic and average hotel room rates. Strip gaming revenue rose 0.7%, while convention attendance increased 6.0%. Meanwhile, occupancy fell, fewer passengers passed through Harry Reid airport, and the average daily room rate dropped from $162.37 to $150.32. See what those changes mean for planning a trip, why an average room rate is not your complete vacation bill, and why these figures do not establish what caused the slowdown.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
